SELECT sm.*, t.role FROM sys_menu sm LEFT JOIN ( SELECT sm.menu_id, GROUP_CONCAT( sr.role_code ) role FROM sys_menu sm LEFT JOIN sys_role_menu srm ON sm.menu_id = srm.menu_id LEFT JOIN sys_role sr ON sr.role_id = srm.role_id GROUP BY sm.menu_id ) t ON sm.menu_id = t.menu_id
ORDER BY sm.menu_sort
